item.title: Seabourn and The Atlantic Launch New Onboard Event Series
item.description: Seabourn teams up with The Atlantic for a three-year series of onboard events, culminating in a 2028 Montreal to Boston sailing with exclusive programming.

item.title: Margaritaville at Sea Launches Zac Brown Talent Search
item.description: Margaritaville at Sea launches a talent search for performers to join Zac Brown’s Same Boat venue aboard the new Beachcomber cruise ship.

item.title: Princess Cruises 2027-28 South America &amp;amp; Antarctica Season
item.description: Princess Cruises 2027–28 South America season features Antarctica, Patagonia, 19 destinations, and 15 UNESCO sites on Majestic Princess.

item.title: Mindful in the Maasai Mara
item.description: Kenya’s wild places open a new way of looking at the world and our place in it.

item.title: Holland America Ages First Bourbon at Sea with Jefferson’s
item.description: Holland America and Jefferson’s Bourbon partner to age ocean bourbon at sea, with exclusive onboard releases debuting in 2027.

item.title: Royal Caribbean Introduces Hero of the Seas
item.description: Royal Caribbean reveals Hero of the Seas, its fourth Icon Class ship debuting in Miami in August 2027 with new slides, nine pools, 28 dining venues and family-focused stays.

item.title: New Tech Down Ancient Trails
item.description: Discover the less-traveled part of Scotland with an Outer Hebrides e-bike tour

item.title: MSC Cruise Revises Winter 2026–2027 Deployment
item.description: MSC Cruise revises its Winter 2026–2027 program, deploying MSC World Europa to the Southern Caribbean with sailings from Martinique, Guadeloupe, and Barbados.

item.title: Explora Journeys Reveals Mediterranean Winter on EXPLORA II
item.description: Explora Journeys unveils A Mediterranean Winter aboard EXPLORA II, with 46 destinations, overnight stays, and slower travel across Europe and North Africa.

item.title: PortMiami Welcomes Norwegian Luna
item.description: PortMiami welcomes Norwegian Luna, sailing Bahamas and Caribbean itineraries through 2027 with new onboard features and expanded routes.

item.title: F&amp;B@Sea Returns to Miami
item.description: F&amp;B@Sea returns to Miami April 15–16, 2026 with its largest event yet, featuring Marcus Samuelsson, 180+ vendors, and expanded cruise F&amp;B programming.

item.title: Oceania Cruises Launches First Floating Pastry Academy
item.description: Oceania Cruises launches the first floating pastry academy, training 200+ chefs through a three-year program with The Butter Book.

item.description: In this episode, I sit down with Brent Horowitz and the team at MTN Global to break down the technology behind connectivity at sea.

item.title: Captain Waymo?
item.description: Self-driving ships have made their debut. Now what?
